plan.baselines: Past unconditional frequencies and pooled reversal frequencies on identical selected samples.
plan.bootstrap: 2000 noncircular seven-day moving blocks, seed271028; fixed fitted-model uncertainty only.
plan.gate: Primary selected coverage >=5%, accuracy >=52%, paired 7-day block bootstrap lower95 accuracy >50% and Brier gain vs unconditional >0; no selected log-loss degradation; positive selected Brier gain in >=5 months with >=100 calls each; >=100 calls in each predicted direction. No primary success claimed from secondary horizons.
plan.method: Pool positive and negative input returns by sign symmetry. Model relative reversal/flat/continuation frequencies in 12 fixed cells: abs(current return / past60 RMS) bins [.5,1,2] x trades/past60 mean bins [.5,1.5]. Shrink each cell by 100 pseudo-observations toward pooled relative frequencies. Add-one global priors. No optimization.
plan.protected: No data >=2026-08-01; no changes to any previous protocol or model.
plan.reason: Follow-up after the microdirection results: flow hurts, small price signal remains. These historical outcomes were already inspected; this is explicitly exploratory.
plan.selection: Emit directional signal only for nonzero observed move and absolute predicted down or up probability >=.52. Otherwise abstain. Selection uses only past-fitted probabilities. Score all samples and selected samples separately; retain flat outcomes as errors for directional calls.
plan.target: Down, exactly flat, up over 1,5,15 minutes after a one-minute delay; primary five minutes.
plan.training: Monthly 90-day history, only matured labels; identical samples to initial experiment delay=1.
